_comment: Statement pairs written for the decision evaluation from the fictional example kit (examples/interview/jobs/gamma-platform: its scenes, resume and portfolio) and the fictional person of examples/sample_ko.json. a is what the person says in an interview, b what a submitted document says. Every contradiction is planted: the kit's own one (the rollback took about 5 minutes against 4) and others of each kind the consistency audit looks for (number, date, title, place, share of the work). The consistent pairs restate the documents. Twelve pairs in English, twelve in Korean.
